description: This PHP script manages the editing interface for code trackers in the TestLink project, including rendering GUI, handling actions like create, edit, delete, and connection checks, and initializing page arguments and user rights.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Handles GUI rendering based on action, either displaying a template or redirecting.

methods.name: initScript
methods.description: Initializes script components, including command manager, arguments, and GUI state.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments based on a whitelist.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI state, including user rights and linked test projects.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has management rights for code tracker.
